name: Policy answers take ages
summary: Turns a customer's policy question on a Zendesk ticket into a reply drawn from the help centre, queues it for a person to approve, and chases it when the ticket goes unanswered. Crons read and draft; a person approves every reply.

help-centre-answer.evidence: No call counts: financial-services-policy-variants.json is missing from the mining folder

system-and-insurer-answer.evidence: No call counts: financial-services-policy-variants.json is missing from the mining folder

crons.name: intake
crons.summary: New open tickets from Zendesk, optionally limited to one group.

crons.name: draft
crons.summary: Match each new question to a help centre article and queue the reply for approval, or park it for a person.

crons.name: follow-up
crons.summary: Close sent answers whose tickets are solved, queue chasers that are due (22:00 UTC is 8 or 9 am in eastern Australia).

draft_ops_note: Reads only. A reply or chaser is a public ticket comment, which the customer receives, so it is a live operation and waits for a person.

zendesk.covers: ticket intake, help centre search, the queued reply and the chaser

gaps: The variants file mining/financial-services-policy-variants.json is missing, so the steps come from the spec alone and no call counts are given. Rebuild the record once it exists.
No policy administration or insurer platform is mapped in the kit. Checking the policy system, asking the insurer for a ruling and chasing a broker are skill steps.
Zendesk's docs do not cover insurer rulings, approval, chasing, or linking a policy record to a ticket. Confirm these on a live account.
Escalation (routing attributes) is a skill step. core.SetTicketAttributeValues is mapped but not wired, since it changes live routing.
Only the first page of help centre articles (100) is searched. Pagination is not built.
Contact name and email are not read from the requester, so replies go on the ticket and not by email.
core/capabilities.json has no tickets entry, so this record uses messages and documents. Add a tickets capability in core/ to record it properly.
No other platform had docs for this workflow, so Zendesk is the only adapter. Docs-only until a sandbox account proves it.

evidence.calls: 3 discovery calls in the worklist; no call-level variants were available
evidence.platforms: Zendesk help centre and ticket docs, mapped step by step; no other platform had docs
